purpose: Same-gain learning attribution, smoothing and predictor-objective diagnosis; no new policy training
changes: Three predefined new profiles only: age-filtered cap0.25, predictive-filtered local constant curvature, predictive-filtered with same observable curvature previews. All use tau0.1s smoothing. Original age-gain is unchanged cap0.5; every profile receives identical PPO/student/fixed proposals with its own causal closed-loop history.
safety_semantics: Unchanged50ms age rejection, sequence/finite/envelope checks and exact LQR fallback for delayed unavailable residual. Residual filter resets immediately on rejection; old information never survives stale revocation. No residual safety certificate.

nominal_psf.paper: Wabersich and Zeilinger arXiv1812.05506v4 section4.1 Eq5 / Algorithm1 nominal specialization
nominal_psf.backup: On infeasible full horizon re-solve remaining horizon from last feasible plan; at terminal use local baseline. If both fail, empirical LQR fallback is logged, not certified safe.
nominal_psf.outer_wrapper: Same50ms freshness rejection; desired=baseline+0.5*PPO residual. No hidden plant parameters. Speed rounded0.1m/s and local curvature assumed constant.
nominal_psf.limits: Nominal linear-model specialization implemented from supplied primary equations, not authors code or uncertainty-aware Algorithm2 reproduction. Model certainty, fixed dynamics/curvature and state knowledge assumptions do not hold exactly on nonlinear/noisy plant; published safety theorem does not transfer.

acceptance: Select among THREE NEW profiles only if PPO mean penalized lateral RMSE >=1% lower than LQR AND same-profile student AND BOTH constants; all3 seed gains positive vs student; no survival loss; nominal <=1.02 LQR; headingRMSE and steeringRateRMS <=1.05 LQR. Rank eligible profiles by lateral RMSE then profile order. Original age profile is attribution reference, not a posthoc selected winner.
reserved: Previous reserved data remain unopened. Any new confirmation must be separately frozen after development eligibility AND observed local10ms timing pass. Do not open confirmation on failure.
stop: No training, no extra profile, gain, filter, horizon or threshold search after outcomes. Publish all failed outcomes, model/source hashes, true heading/steering and solver fallbacks. Hardware/target-laptop and global hard-real-time claims require external evidence.
